strings.(포보스 한쪽에 있는 환의 요람 입구, 발드릭이 앉은 채로 눈을 감고 뭔: (At the entrance to the Cradle of Illusions in a corner of Phobos, Valdrick sits with his eyes closed, apparently deep in thought.)
strings.아우님, 반가워! 나 보러 온 거야?: Good to see you! Did you come to visit me?
Yes, Valdrick. Everyone asked me to visit. I suppose you weren't one of them.
strings.그렇긴 한데, 당장 바쁜 건 없다는 거지? 나와 대련할래?: True, but that means you're not busy right now, doesn't it? Want to spar?
Then may I learn a thing or two from you? Keep it short, please.
strings.(발드릭이 벅찬 표정으로 %s의 어깨를 두드린다.): (Overcome with delight, Valdrick pats %s on the shoulder.)
strings.역시 아우님 밖에 없다니까. 어디 보자. 시간은 딱 30분, 어때?: I knew I could count on you. Let's see. Exactly thirty minutes. How's that?
Let's give it everything we've got, short of killing each other.
What? Short of killing each other? Aaaah...
strings.(갑자기 %s의 머리 옆으로 발드릭의 주먹이 날아온다. 서둘러 피하긴 했: (Valdrick's fist suddenly flies past %s's head. You dodge just in time, but a boulder behind you shatters.)
strings.(계속해서 발드릭의 공격이 이어지고, 받아치거나 피하는 방식으로 둘만의: (Valdrick keeps attacking, and the two continue their sparring match through counters and evasions.)
strings.(윽, 이번엔 피하기 힘들겠어.): (Ugh, this one's going to be hard to dodge.)
strings.(그대로 눈을 감고 공격이 들어오길 기다리고 있던 %s의 귓가에 기쁜 발: (With eyes shut, %s braces for the blow, only to hear Valdrick's cheerful voice.)
Hahaha, that was fun. On your feet.
strings.(발드릭이 %s의 손을 붙잡고 일으켜 세운다.): (Valdrick takes %s's hand and pulls you up.)
Whew! Those were the longest thirty minutes of my life.
Here, have some water and rest.
strings.고마워요, 발드릭. 그런데 아까 무슨 생각을 그렇게 한 거예요?: Thank you, Valdrick. What were you thinking about earlier?
strings.꿈자리가 이상해서 자다 깼지 뭐야. 스승이 나와서 뭐라 뭐라 한 것 같은: A strange dream woke me up. My master appeared and said something, but I can't remember it clearly.
...I think I was looking for something...
strings.가는 건 괜찮은데, 저 조금만 쉬었다 가면 안될까요? 어? 어어어어?: I don't mind going, but could I rest a little first? Huh? Wh-whoa!
(Without waiting for %s's agreement, Valdrick lifts you onto his shoulder. With an apologetic look, he runs toward the Cradle of Illusions.)
strings.(발드릭이 환의 요람 한쪽에서 발견된 작은 보석을 들어보인다.): (Valdrick holds up a small gem found in a corner of the Cradle of Illusions.)
strings.이건 연옥과 비슷한 느낌이 들어요. 연옥 안에 있던 이상한 존재들이 들고: It feels like Purgatory. Those strange beings inside were carrying something like it...
strings.아, 이게 그거군. 그런데 이게 왜 여기 있는 거야?: Oh, so that's what it is. But why is it here?
I can smell the Demon Realm...
strings.살다보니 그렇게 됐어. 벨레드 아우님한테 가지고 가볼까? 뭔가 알고 있을: You live long enough, you pick things up. Shall we take it to our friend Veled? He might know something.
strings.텐트가 바람에 날아가는걸 같이 찾아줬거든. 우물에 들어갈 뻔 한 걸 겨우: I helped him chase down his tent when the wind blew it away. Barely caught it before it went down the well.
So he still hasn't managed to secure it.
He thanked me and said to come by anytime I needed help.
strings.잠시만요. 저 걸어갈 거니까 어깨에 태우지 마세요!: Wait! I'm walking, so don't put me on your shoulder!
strings.후우. 아름다운 성, 제발 날아가지 마. 우물 안으로 떨어지면 어디로 가: Sigh. Beautiful castle, please don't blow away. If you fall down that well, I won't know where to go.
strings.(텐트의 끈을 잡아당겨 고정시키는 벨레드의 시야에 발드릭과 %s의 모습이: (As Veled tightens the tent ropes, Valdrick and %s come into view.)
It's been a while, %s. Valdrick and I were talking about you a few hours ago. How you defeated Weiss...
strings.그리고 바이스가 사용했던 마석이 어떤 용도로 쓰이고 어떻게 만들어졌는지를: And what the magic stones Weiss used were for, and how they were made...
And I used those stones to...
strings.나 괜찮아. 바이스 이야기하니까 약간 기분이 별로여서 그래. 후후, 잘: I'm fine. Talking about Weiss spoiled my mood a little. Hehe, watch. I'm beautiful again already.
strings.%s 덕분에 피오니아 걱정도 줄어든 것 같아. 마르스도 이제 좀 더 좋아: Peonia seems to have fewer worries thanks to you, %s. Mars should improve now too, right?
It should. She said she'd work things out with the representatives from each village.
I just hope they don't start fighting like in the old days. Peonia will be busy.
strings.포보스도 전보다 공기가 맑아진 것 같아. 나쁜 기운이 대륙에서 사라진 영: The air in Phobos seems clearer than before, too. Maybe it's because the evil energy left the continent?
strings.나 공기가 맑아진게 느껴져. 나쁜 기운이 싹 사라지니까 마계에 다녀왔다는: I can feel how clear the air is. With all that bad energy gone, it's hard to believe I've just been to the Demon Realm.
strings.응, 마계. 어떻게 하다보니 다녀오게 됐어. 그런데 다시 가는 방법을 모: Yes, the Demon Realm. One thing led to another, and I went there. But I don't know how to get back.
strings.그러고보니 아우님, 악마였지?: Come to think of it, my friend, you're a devil, aren't you?
strings.발드릭, 나 악마야. 아니, 악마는 아니지만, 악마는 맞는 것 같고, 악: Valdrick, I am a devil. No, I'm not, but I suppose I am. Still, aren't I too beautiful even to pretend to be one?
strings.(벨레드가 아름답다며 자신을 가리키지만 아무도 관심을 두지 않는다.): (Veled gestures to his own beauty, but no one pays attention.)
strings.그냥 잠깐 다녀와서 나에게 별 관심을 두지 않더라고. 몽마의 영역은 '로: I only visited briefly, so no one took much notice of me. Rosengarten isn't the only realm of the dream demons...
strings.뭘 좀 알아보려고 갔는데, 수확은 없었어. 나중에 기회가 되면 또 가보지: I went to investigate something, but found nothing. I'll try again if I get the chance. What's that you're carrying?
strings.나 들고 있는 물건에서 마계의 기운이 느껴져서 말해줄 때까지 기다리려고: I can sense the Demon Realm's energy from it. I was going to wait for you to explain, but I can't. Give it here.
We got so caught up talking, I forgot. Here.
strings.(발드릭을 만나 꿈 이야기를 듣고 환의 요람을 갔고, 그 안에서 어둠의: (You explain that you met Valdrick, heard about his dream, and went to the Cradle of Illusions, where you found a teardrop-shaped gem filled with dark power.)
It's like the one a being from another world had in Avalon.
strings.아우님도 잘 모르겠어?: You don't know either, my friend?
strings.어둠이 깊게 들어있는 물건이네…. 뭐가 들어있는지는 살펴봐야겠어. 그런데: There's deep darkness within this... I'll have to examine what's inside. But why was it found there? Rosengarten definitely disappeared...
Did a gate to the Demon Realm open? If it had, Valdrick and I surely would have noticed...
strings.%s…. 나 조금 더 확인할 시간이 필요해. 그러니까 저기를 한 번 다녀: %s... I need more time to examine it. Could you go over there?
That well you can see over there. I sense something inside...
Shall I come too? That dream still bothers me.
strings.(로젠가르텐으로 들어갔던 우물쪽으로 두 사람이 내려가자 벨레드가 조용히: (As the two descend toward the well that once led to Rosengarten, Veled quietly studies the object in his hand.)
I have a feeling someone left this here deliberately...
Let me see those, my friend.
Why are these here? They belong to my master...
strings.네? 스승님 안경 맞아요?: What? Are you sure they're your master's glasses?
strings.맞아. 시간이 흘렀어도, 내가 머리가 나쁘다고 해도 기억력은 좋아. 이건: Yes. Time may have passed, and I may not be clever, but my memory is good. These are definitely hers.
Your master died centuries ago, didn't she?
strings.마계의 흔적이 있던 곳에서 발견된 안경…. 꿈자리가 사나웠던 게 이런 이: Her glasses, found where there were traces of the Demon Realm... Is that why I had such an unsettling dream?
My friend, let's go back to Veled for now.
strings.(벨레드가 발드릭이 건넨 안경을 유심히 살펴본다.): (Veled carefully examines the glasses Valdrick has handed him.)
About these... I'm not certain, but...
strings.나 같이 아름다운 존재 말고 다른 악마나 마족들 만난 적 있지?: You've met devils or demons besides a beautiful being like me, haven't you?
strings.날 쓰러뜨리겠다고 찾아온 놈들을 만난 적은 있지. 아우님, 그런데 그게: A few came looking to defeat me. But what does that have to do with this, my friend?
strings.벨레드, 혹시 그 안경에 마계의 힘이 깃들었나요?: Veled, do those glasses contain power from the Demon Realm?
strings.나 아니라고는 못하겠어. 보통 안경이 아닌 건 확실해. 그리고 말해줄 게: I can't say they don't. They certainly aren't ordinary glasses. And there's something I should tell you. That object you brought me earlier...
Watch closely. The gem and these glasses...
strings.(벨레드가 탁자 대신으로 쓰고 있는 상자 위에 안경과 깊은 어둠의 눈물을: (Veled places the glasses and the Tear of Deep Darkness together on a crate he uses as a table. The two objects tremble as though resonating.)
A reaction like this means they had the same owner, or their owners are connected.
strings.(잠시 후, 깊은 어둠의 눈물이라 불리던 보석이 갈라지면서 부서진다.): (A moment later, the gem called the Tear of Deep Darkness cracks and shatters.)
strings.맞아. 이 보석은 다른 세계의 힘이 담겨 있고, 이 안경은 확실히 마계의: Right. The gem held power from another world, while these glasses are definitely of the Demon Realm...
strings.(발드릭이 상자 위에 있던 안경을 챙기자 벨레드가 의아한 표정으로 바라본: (Veled watches in puzzlement as Valdrick picks up the glasses from the crate.)
strings.그래서 아우님이 더 알 수 있는 건 없다는 거지?: So there's nothing more you can tell, my friend?
strings.응, 맞아. 나 알고 있는 건, 전부 아스모데아의 기억과 경험에서 나온: That's right. Everything I know comes from Asmodea's memories and experiences.
strings.바이스 놈이 사라져서 당장 뭘 하면 좋을지 잠깐 고민했었는데, 잘 됐지: With Weiss gone, I was wondering what to do next. This works out nicely. If I take these glasses and look for demons, I'll learn something about my master.
Now I'm curious. Perhaps I knew far too little about her.
strings.그게 그렇게 단순한 문제가 아닌 것 같은데요?: I don't think it's that simple.
Let's keep it simple, my friend. Complicated things are a bother.
strings.발드릭이면 잘 할 거야. 설마 마계라도 박살내겠어?: Valdrick will manage. It's not as though he'll smash the Demon Realm to pieces.
strings.정말 그렇게 할 것 같아서 무서운데요?: The frightening thing is, I think he might.
strings.마계가 박살나면 인간계에 좋은 일 아닐까? 안 그래도 마계의 존재들이 여: Wouldn't destroying the Demon Realm be good for the human world? Its creatures seem intent on coming after us.
strings.…그거야 그렇지만, 그래도 무슨 일이 생길 것 같아서. 그래서 마계에 어: ...Perhaps, but I still feel something might happen. How are you going to get to the Demon Realm?
strings.다른 대륙을 오고 가면서 마계로 가는 문이 있다는 이야기를 들었는데, 그: While traveling between continents, I heard there's a gate to it somewhere. I don't know where.
strings.그러니까 찾을 거야. 어차피 시간은 많으니까. 하하하, 고마워. %s 아: So I'll find it. I have plenty of time, after all. Hahaha. Thank you, my friends. %s, Veled.
strings.(말이 끝나기 무섭게 발드릭이 서둘러 어딘가를 향해 달려간다.): (No sooner has he finished speaking than Valdrick races away.)
strings.발드릭? 발드릭? 갑자기 어디 가요?: Valdrick? Valdrick? Where are you going all of a sudden?
strings.인간이 되면 저런 면도 생기는 건가?: Do you become like that when you're human?
strings.벨레드, 인간이 되는 방법을 찾았어요?: Veled, have you found a way to become human?
Not yet... I'm still looking. There's something about souls I need to investigate.
strings.나중에 뭔가 알게 되면 이야기해줄게. 어?: I'll tell you when I learn something. Oh?
strings.(벨레드가 자신에게 다가오는 어떤 일행의 모습을 보더니 표정이 확 달라진: (Veled's expression changes completely at the sight of a group approaching.)
Veled, don't cling to me. Oh, %s... It's been a while.
Ahaha, my friends. I'm back too.
strings.모두 반가워요. 발드릭은 아까 봤으니 됐고. 그런데 다들 무슨 일이에요?: Good to see everyone. Except you, Valdrick—I just saw you. What brings you all here?
We came to eat with Veled. No, to talk.
Uncle Valdrick suddenly snatched up the meat barrel. It startled me.
So that's why you rushed off.
strings.피오니아, 무슨 이야기야? 무슨 이야기야?: What is it, Peonia? What did you want to say?
I have good news for everyone. You see...
strings.마르스에서 벨레드와 발드릭 아저씨의 거처를 마련하기로 했거든요. 피오 언: Mars has decided to provide homes for Veled and Uncle Valdrick. Peo worked hard to make it happen.
strings.정말? 정말? 피오니아, 고마워! 나 너무 좋아!: Really? Really? Thank you, Peonia! I'm so happy!
strings.벨레드, 가!! 갑자기 다, 다가오지 말라고!!: Veled, back off! D-don't come so close all of a sudden!
strings.(피오니아가 들이미는 벨레드의 얼굴에 당황해하면서 살짝 밀어낸다.): (Flustered by Veled's face drawing near, Peonia gently pushes him away.)
strings.아하하, 아우님, 잘됐어! 잘됐다고! 그러니까 이 고기들 다 구워 먹자고: Ahaha, my friend! Wonderful! Wonderful news! Now let's grill all this meat!
strings.왜 결론이 고기로 되는지는 알 수 없지만, 하여튼 잘 됐네요!: I don't know how the answer to everything is meat, but I'm happy for you!
strings.…이게 다 데이모스 교단이 사라져서 가능했던 일이야. %s하고 발드릭 아: ...This was only possible because the Deimos Order is gone. Thank you, %s and Uncle Valdrick. And you worked hard too, Veled...
strings.나도 열심히 할게. 앞으로 마르스를 부흥시키려면 지금보다 더 열심히 일할: I'll work hard as well. Harder than ever, to help Mars flourish again. I'm counting on all of you.
strings.(피오니아가 희망찬 미소를 짓자 모두들 따뜻한 미소로 화답한다. 단 한: (Everyone answers Peonia's hopeful smile with warmth. Except Valdrick, who laughs loudly instead.)
strings.하하하하, 그러면 다같이 고기 먹자고!: Hahahaha! Then let's all eat meat!
strings.(발드릭의 한 마디에 모두들 웃음이 터지고, 피오니아와 크리시엔이 준비했: (Valdrick's words make everyone burst into laughter, and Peonia and Crisien set out the food they prepared.)
strings.(훗날, 발드릭은 벨레드의 아름다운 성 앞에서 했던 식사를 이렇게 말한다: (Later, Valdrick would describe the meal in front of Veled's beautiful castle as a beautiful banquet of people dreaming of a bright future.)
